caption: Page 204 of the 1870 first edition of Kennan's Tent Life in Siberia, describing the Koryak fly-agaric ("toadstool") habit.
alt: Printed page headed "TENT LIFE IN SIBERIA" and numbered 204, describing a Korak host's invitation "Won't you come in and take a toadstool?" and the difficulty of supplying the stimulant to a whole band.
credit: Internet Archive / G. P. Putnam's Sons, New York, 1870
note: The hosted transcript's textSource is the Project Gutenberg text (no images); this is the corresponding page in the 1870 first-edition Internet Archive scan (item tentlifeinsiberi00kenn), leaf 219, found via the search-inside API for "toadstool" and matching chapter XIX ("Won't you take a Toadstool?") in this edition's table of contents (numbered differently than the Gutenberg edition's chap. XVII).
